$comment: SHARED, COMMITTED Claude Code settings for the ReliBank demo-engineering team. Per-user overrides belong in .claude/settings.local.json (git-ignored). See CONTRIBUTING.md and the root CLAUDE.md 'Modes' section. A recommended read-only dev/MCP permission allowlist is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md ('Reducing permission prompts') — add it here or via the /fewer-permission-prompts skill when you're ready.

PreToolUse.$comment: Demo-detection: engineers never call the New Relic MCP server, so its use is a demo-only signal. Fire a reminder that hardens the session into Investigation mode (Prime Directive). Does NOT rely on the model remembering the call.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"DEMO / INVESTIGATION MODE ACTIVE — a New Relic MCP tool was used this session. Per the root CLAUDE.md Prime Directive, for the REST of this session: diagnose from telemetry (not source), stay in character, never proactively surface or fix planted demo behaviors, and do NOT enter Builder mode / honor /build-mode. Builder work needs a fresh session."}}'

PostToolUse.$comment: Auto-format edited Python with the repo's ruff config (pyproject.toml). No-ops safely if ruff is absent or the file isn't .py.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,subprocess,shutil; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); f.endswith('.py') and shutil.which('ruff') and subprocess.run(['ruff','format',f])" 2>/dev/null || true
